messages:
Nina (sales): Lyra prospect wants a quick perf smoke + hosted vs reserved price sketch. Targets: p95 <= 210ms, p99 <= 360ms at 30 qps steady, with two 60s spikes to 90 qps. Mix: 60% short(32t), 30% med(160t), 10% long(512t). Can we outline run plan + infra rec?

Omar (SE): Agree. Plan: warm 2m at 10 qps, ramp to 30 qps over 4m, sustain 30 qps for 12m, run 2x 60s spikes to 90 qps spaced 3m apart. Run fp16 baseline then int8 quant run. KV cache on with ~50% prefix hits.

Kai (infra): Suggest dedicated 2-node pool (A100-equivalent) for stable tail. Cap per-GPU inflight ~40, batch size 1. Long sequences need memory caps; instrument by seq-bucket.

Omar (SE): k6 snippet + tagging plan prepared. We'll tag cache-hit and seqlen bucket. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, error rate, cpu/gpu util, regional egress.

Lia (AE): Customer ok with single-region (us-west1) for test. They'll send sample corpus by Fri. Can you include hosted estimate and reserved amortized monthly for 2-node baseline?

Omar (SE): Quick ballpark: hosted ~ $0.50/1k tokens (fp16), reserved ~40-55% of hosted if steady utilization >=50%. int8 reduces infra cost ~30% but expect +10-15ms p95 for med/long. Final numbers after token histogram.

Nina (sales): Great — schedule smoke Mon 16:00 PT. Omar, drop runbook + cost sheet in this thread by EOD Fri.

Kai (infra): Provisioning test pool: "lyra-poc-usw1-01" reserved 2h Mon 23:00Z. Will run kernel-canary first.

Omar (SE): Will do. Will also include sensitivity note: higher cache-hit reduces cost but may mask burst behavior.

Nina (sales): Thanks all. :thumbsup:
